sources.title: Home - Speech recognition in agriculture and finance for the poor
sources.snippet: Speech recognition in agriculture and finance for the poor is an initiative predominantly to create resources and make them available as a digital public good in the open source domain to spur research and innovation in speech recognition in nine different Indian languages in the area of agriculture and finance.
